recipe.visualDefinition: A 1980s-inspired collage featuring a central yellow-toned classical male bust floating over a technical blueprint of clockwork gears. The composition is split by a diagonal light blue band against a deep cobalt background, accented by sharp geometric typography and small triangular markers.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic yellow subject against high-contrast blue backgrounds
Juxtaposition of organic human form with rigid mechanical schematics
Diagonal structural division creating dynamic tension
Repetitive triangular motifs acting as rhythmic anchors
coreInvariants: Technical line-art overlay on mechanical elements
Grainy, airbrushed texture on the central bust

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central male bust, scaled to occupy the middle third of the frame, slightly tilted.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large golden gear at the bottom right of the diagonal band.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-left display text leads down the diagonal band to the central face, then follows the gear curve to the bottom-right script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep cobalt blue blocks at the top and bottom provide breathing room for the dense central technical imagery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue background and light blue diagonal band.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the central bust, gears, and primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the secondary script and technical degree markers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue vs. high value yellow creates a vibrating, high-contrast 80s palette.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Small triangular serifs or 'feet' added to the base of vertical stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'A' with a long, sweeping horizontal crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, vertical geometric sans and fluid, horizontal script.
graphicDevices: Row of small yellow triangles pointing downward
Degree symbols (60°, 30°) in condensed yellow type

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ultra-condensed verticality of the display text.
Approximates the fluid, connected feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen composition with a dark cobalt blue background. Add a wide light-blue diagonal band across the center. In the band, place a yellow-tinted classical male bust floating over a complex blueprint of golden gears and mechanical drawings. Add a row of small yellow triangles at the top and bottom edges of the blue fields.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed yellow sans-serif text at the top. Add a white fluid script at the bottom right. Place yellow degree markers (60 and 30) along the diagonal band edges.

verificationChecks: Is the central bust monochromatic yellow?
Does the diagonal band contain technical blueprint lines?
Are the top letters extremely tall and narrow?
Is the background a deep, saturated cobalt?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the bust
postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is legible against the blue.
Ensure the gears look like technical drawings, not realistic photos.
Verify the diagonal band is straight and clean.
Confirm the script text is white and placed in the bottom right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Classical Subject] + [Technical Blueprint] + [Diagonal Color Block] + [Ultra-Condensed Typography] using a [Yellow/Blue] palette.
